_source: NJ Division of Disability Services, Mental Health page: https://www.nj.gov/disabilities/employment-independent-living/mental-health/ (read 2026-09-25). Resources already in the main list are left out.

dmhas-treatment-connection.name: NJ Division of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS)
dmhas-treatment-connection.description: Helps adults get connected to mental health and substance use treatment services across New Jersey.

county-mh-administrators.name: County Alcohol and Drug Directors and County Mental Health Administrators
county-mh-administrators.description: Contact list for each county's drug and alcohol director and mental health administrator, who can help find local treatment.

access-asl-calling-center.name: ACCESS Mental Health Calling Center (ASL)
access-asl-calling-center.description: Emotional support directly in American Sign Language for Deaf New Jerseyans, by videophone.

dmhas-ombudsman.name: DMHAS Ombudsman
dmhas-ombudsman.description: Advocate for people receiving DMHAS mental health or addiction services. Helps resolve problems with services, navigate the system and find referrals.

nj-wellness-workbook.name: NJ Eight Domains of Wellness Workbook
nj-wellness-workbook.description: Free workbook with exercises for physical, emotional, financial, social, spiritual, occupational, intellectual and environmental wellness.

mhanj-wrap.name: Wellness Recovery Action Planning (WRAP), Mental Health Association in NJ
mhanj-wrap.description: A structured program, developed by and for people with mental health conditions, to set wellness goals and manage symptoms.

uwill-college.name: Uwill (NJ college students)
uwill-college.description: Free 24/7 virtual mental health support for New Jersey college students, including teletherapy and crisis support.

signs-of-sobriety.name: Signs of Sobriety
signs-of-sobriety.description: Information, referral and communication access (such as interpreters) for Deaf and hard of hearing people seeking substance use recovery and Twelve Step meetings in New Jersey.

aspire-blind.name: ASPIRE peer support groups (Commission for the Blind and Visually Impaired)
aspire-blind.description: Statewide peer support groups where people with vision loss connect, share information and support each other.

eye2eye.name: Eye2Eye
eye2eye.description: Free phone-based peer support for adults who are blind or visually impaired, and their families.

care2caregivers.name: Care2Caregivers
care2caregivers.description: Peer-led support for people caring for a family member or friend with dementia in New Jersey.

well-spouse.name: Well Spouse Association
well-spouse.description: Peer support groups and online support for people caring for a chronically ill or disabled spouse.

centers-independent-living.name: Centers for Independent Living
centers-independent-living.description: Community organizations offering people with disabilities life skills training, advocacy, information and referral, peer counseling and social activities.

nj-self-help-clearinghouse.name: NJ Self-Help Group Clearinghouse
nj-self-help-clearinghouse.description: Finds self-help groups for mental health conditions, addiction, chronic illness, grief and other life challenges. Run by the Mental Health Association in NJ.

nj-peer-warm-line.name: NJ Peer Recovery Warm Line
nj-peer-warm-line.description: Non-crisis, peer-run support line. Trained peers with lived experience offer listening, support and referrals.

mom2mom.name: Mom2Mom Helpline
mom2mom.description: Mental health and peer support for mothers of children with special needs, answered by moms of special needs children trained in peer counseling and crisis support.

reeve-paralysis-center.name: Christopher & Dana Reeve Paralysis Resource Center
reeve-paralysis-center.description: Virtual support groups and peer mentors for people living with paralysis. Based in Short Hills, NJ.
